_readme: Answer option -> status type, from Leisure_Care_Oregon_RET_ABST_Build_List_v3 (tab 4). Types: staff | nurse | outside | notApplicable | independent. Keyed by RET domain + normalized question text + normalized answer text (lowercase, numbering stripped). Edit or regenerate when the RET changes; answers not listed fall back to wording-based rules and are flagged in the report. Corrections to v3 (marked correctedFrom): the four "No assistance with ... is needed" medication answers are notApplicable; "Independent with oxygen use" is independent; oxygen equipment/descriptor answers are informational (they do not drive status). Bathing Preferences answers are informational (preferences, not assistance).
